title: code-review-pr-notes-prefetch-kv-cache
content:
Context:
Personal scratchpad for PR review: PR #1234 'prefetch-kv-cache' (serving runtime). Knocked out an initial pass during pairing with Priya. Keeping notes + checklist for follow-ups and refactor ideas.

Quick summary of changes in the PR:
- Adds a prefetch path for KV cache to prime long-running sessions when prefix tokens are reused.
- Introduces PrefetchManager (new package eng/serving-runtime/prefetch) with a simple LRU-based prefetch queue.
- Modifies runtime request pipeline to optionally call PrefetchManager.prefetch(prefix_hash, seq) before decode.
- Adds metrics: prefetch_count, prefetch_hit, prefetch_latency_ms.
- Tests: unit tests for the LRU queue + an integration test simulating repeated prefix queries.

Notes to self (high-level concerns):
- Safety: ensure prefetch doesn't leak contexts between users (prefix_hash must include tenant id). PR currently uses PrefixHasher.hash(prefix) but not tenant-scoped. -> SECURITY RISK.
- Concurrency: PrefetchManager currently uses a mutex around the LRU queue. Might be a contention hotspot under high QPS. Consider shard-based locks or lock-free ring buffer.
- Latency regression: prefetch path is executed on the request critical path right now (awaited). Idea: make it best-effort and background (fire-and-forget) when SLOs are tight.
- Memory: prefetch keeps cached KV segments for primed sessions. Need eviction policy tied to memory budget per pool. Current LRU is global; should be per-GPU or per-pool.

Quick review checklist (items for reviewer to tick / developer to address):
[ ] Confirm prefix hashing uses tenant+model+route (security).
[ ] Add unit test for tenant-scoped hash collisions (edge cases).
[ ] Evaluate lock contention: benchmark with 1000 concurrent prefetch requests.
[ ] Move long-running IO off the request critical path (convert to background job).
[ ] Add metrics for prefetch_background_queue_length and prefetch_dropped_due_to_backpressure.
[ ] Ensure metrics tags include model, region, pool_id.
[ ] Add config flag and default: prefetch.enabled=true, prefetch.mode=background|sync, prefetch.max_per_pool=16.
[ ] Update docs/ops-runbook snippet for tuning prefetch controls and memory limits.
[ ] Add integration test demonstrating no data leak across tenants.

Refactor ideas / follow-ups (non-blocking improvements):
- PrefetchManager refactor: extract interface IPrefetchStore (Get(kvKey), Put(kvSegment), Remove) to allow in-memory LRU, redis-backed store, or pooled storage. This will help private deployments use HSM-friendly stores.
- Replace global LRU with sharded LRU by pool_id: reduces mutex contention and allows per-pool budgeting.
- Introduce a backpressure mechanism: if prefetch queue > soft_limit, sample requests (1/N) rather than prefetch for all. Add adaptive sampler based on CPU/GPU load.
- Consider integrating with the existing caching layer (cache-coordinator) instead of separate manager — reduces duplication.
- Move heavy serialization/deserialization off main path: pre-serialize KV segments when enqueued.

Follow-ups / Action items (assignments):
- [Jamie] Add tenant scoping to PrefixHasher and add unit test for tenant collisions (due: 2024-10-07).
- [Priya] Prototype sharded LRU and microbenchmark lock contention (due: 2024-10-10).
- [Ethan] Add background-mode option and a minimal background worker (due: 2024-10-12).
- [Platform] Ops doc update: include prefetch config knobs and recommended defaults (owner: SRE; pinged via slack #sre).

Edge cases / unresolved questions:
- Cache invalidation: how do we invalidate prefetch KV segments on model updates or rollouts? Should be tied to model version id in cache key.
- Backfill vs ephemeral prefetch: Do we persist prefetch across process restarts? For now in-memory only; consider fast warmup store for Dedicated customers.
- How to measure prefetch value: we have prefetch_hit but not downstream token-savings. Need a small eval: synthetic workload measuring tokens saved and latency delta.

Testing notes:
- Unit tests added are good but incomplete: missing tenant-scope test + multi-threaded eviction test.
- Integration test sim simulates 3 tenants; increase to 10 tenants to catch cross-tenant leakage.
- Perf test: run against local gpu-sim harness with 500 concurrent short-prefix requests. Capture mutex wait time and p50/p95 latencies.

PR review comments to post (draft snippets):
- SECURITY: prefix hashing must include tenant id to avoid cross-tenant cache leaks. Please update PrefixHasher and add tests.
- PERFORMANCE: using a single mutex around the LRU queue may become a contention point. Can you add a microbenchmark or justify expected QPS?
- SUGGESTION: make prefetch optional / background - currently it runs on critical path. Consider switching to fire-and-forget for initial rollout.
- DOCS: add runbook notes for tuning prefetch.* flags and memory budgeting per pool.

Notes to include in PR description before merge:
- Mention security fix (tenant scoping) is included.
- Default prefetch.mode should be 'background' for canary rollout.
- Known limitation: in-memory only, no persistence across restarts.

Misc scratchpad (quick commands / links):
- Local perf harness: tools/perf/harness --workload=short-prefix --concurrency=500 --duration=2m
- Microbenchmark script: eng/serving-runtime/tools/prefetch_bench.py
- Related PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-server/pull/1189 (kv-cache baseline)
- Confluence draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/Prefetch+Design (link placeholder)

Personal TODO (followup after merge):
- Add telemetry dashboard tile for prefetch_hit_rate and prefetch_latency broken down by model.
- Schedule 30m sync with SRE to discuss memory budgets for Dedicated pools.

End of notes.
